line_reference_note: Positive findings below reference the initial reviewed source. Final helper is moved after the actual standard proxy service, and the final admission commit guard is at6381..6391.

positive_findings.finding: Only the first valid Held result captures a fixed exact frame, original request origin and observed USB epoch. Busy duplicates cannot replace that state.
Fallback is consulted only after a non-NoAction adapter tick. Other errors retain global fail-closed unless the exact clean deadline predicate passes.

Immutable first failure must be the same-time Tick with both owner/coordinator transitioning AwaitFreshGrant to FailClosed and both exact GrantDeadlineExceeded reasons; stale/fresh/staged/clock/unknown causes cannot be reclassified.
Frozen TDD, session/stream/prefix ownership, protocol/receipt state, high-speed writer, explicit restore, final action identity and stream UART counts refuse fallback.
Existing standard writer lease must retain exact owner/token/generation and non-None action type. No lease reset or takeover is performed.

Revalidated unsigned canonical2-byte nonzero-target PARAM request, empty healthy ingress, inactive proxy and absent pending proxy token are required. Nonempty descriptors are conservatively refused because absence of partial application prefix cannot be proven.
A fresh native proxy lease increment, nonzero token and exact frame equality are proven before normal proxy service; ordinary ingress admission must succeed before acceleration is consumed.

The failed adapter remains failed and is not rearmed. Original t0 and first-failure evidence remain unchanged; acceleration is consumed once, route deselected and held validity cleared only after successful standard queue admission.
Normal and fallback GCS paths share proxy/descriptor processing; no direct UART write, USB debug output or control-frame publication is introduced.

open_review_recommendation.scope: A conditional asynchronous reset race, not an observed experiment root cause.
open_review_recommendation.finding: Serial.txLossEpoch is compared to original held epoch at helper entry, but not after proxy/ingress admission and before marking consumed. If a USB reset ISR increments the epoch during that interval, the current code can label the transition successful without a final matching-epoch witness.
open_review_recommendation.recommendation: Recheck the original held epoch against both observed and current Serial epoch after admission and before consuming acceleration. If changed, retain failure evidence and global fail-closed; do not claim queued bytes were retracted or retry them. A matching post-check is a commit-boundary witness, not proof that USB epoch can never change later.
open_review_recommendation.tests_needed: Deterministically change fake USB loss epoch on a later txLossEpoch sample within the fallback helper; verify global stop, no consumed-success flag, preserved original t0/epoch and no physical write.
open_review_recommendation.resolution: After actual proxy/ingress admission, current source rechecks host/endpoint state plus original held epoch against cached observed and Serial epochs before consuming acceleration. The late reset fixture now globally stops with request unsent, preserving original evidence; it does not claim queue retraction.
open_review_recommendation.hook_scope: Small opt-in fake epoch getter returns the old sample then advances backing epoch immediately, modeling reset after entry sample; disabled by default and reset_platform. No production hook introduced.

test_evidence.legacy_negative_fixture_strengthening: PostHeld simulated epoch loss explicitly preserves global-failure behavior.

limitations: The fallback is a one-shot downgrade to standard R18 proxy behavior, not successful high-speed negotiation or full parameter transfer.
The successful post-fallback primary Heartbeat component test proves one product egress completion, not maximum Heartbeat gap across an entire live run.
All nonempty ordinary ingress FIFOs are conservatively refused, including a complete queued frame for which no prefix actually exists; availability may remain limited.
The R18 proxy has its own ordinary admission/physical-commit watchdog; fallback does not prove original30second global completion target.
Vehicle's independent Grant-tail-to-VCBN500ms requirement is unchanged and remains a separate negotiation constraint.

Fallback count and held-request metadata are ordinary RAM, not additions to the unchanged JTAG diagnostic ABI. Future hardware evaluation must not claim those unread RAM fields were observed; it can correlate only actual bound records, raw traffic and Heartbeat evidence.
No hardware operation, device/process query, network request, firmware upload or extra trial was performed in this review.
